critical_code_review_comments: Backend SCAN_PROMPT explicitly requires visible printed evidence and prohibits loose-tablet identification from appearance.
Notification suppression logic checks any taken schedule entry; for multi-time medicines this may suppress later missed-dose reminders too broadly.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend now has stronger evidence-schema assertions with one retry for transient Gemini 502. Web run validated Privacy dashboard sections and delete-all redirect to language selector. Upload/evidence/reminder E2E remained blocked by upload picker behavior in automation.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: language->dev skip login->scan tab->tap upload (camera-sheet-upload-button or permission-screen-upload-button). Playwright timed out waiting for filechooser and no input[type=file] appeared. Likely either Expo ImagePicker web interaction not exposing chooser in this automation context or click path not dispatching the chooser event in headless mode. Mitigation: confirm manually in browser and on native device, then add a web-test fallback route/hidden test input for deterministic automation.
